$comment: The contract between the two name derivations. crates/think-and-ship/src/roadmap/name.rs seeds a stored name when a chunk is written; frontend/src/tree/name.ts falls back to the same label when a record predates the field and its cloud copy will never be rewritten. The same id must produce the same label whichever side happens to name it, so both languages drive this table and neither owns it. Every id here is foreign on purpose — no project's live roadmap has ever held one — because a derivation only ever exercised against existing data proves nothing about the next chunk anybody writes.
